parameters.query:
WITH upd AS (
    UPDATE findings
    SET review_status = $1::review_status,
        reviewed_at   = NOW(),
        reviewed_by   = $2,
        updated_at    = NOW()
    WHERE id = $3::bigint
      AND review_status = 'pending'
    RETURNING id, review_status
)
SELECT (SELECT id FROM upd) IS NOT NULL     AS updated,
       (SELECT id FROM upd)                 AS finding_id,
       (SELECT review_status FROM upd)      AS review_status;
